articles.summary: Asset-light collaboration with Ai Sakura targeting disciplined, high-margin growth BrilliA Incorporated (NYSE American: BRIA) (“BrilliA” or the “Company”) today announced that its subsidiary, Bra Pro Limited, has entered a commercial collaboration with Tokyo-based Ai Sakura, a performance-driven sportswear brand, to expand into Japan’s higher-margin athleisure market.
